name: Takao Sana
source:
A high school girl who ran away from her home. She is slightly more mature than the girls her age. Many people think she's blunt but in reality she's very mischievous and likes teasing the people around her. She is also good at household chores, cooking being her main forte.
Sana wishes to become an illustrator in the future and has a hobby often sketching in the park, though her art is terrible.
